The '''Quintad''' was the central legislature of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] in the form of an [[oligarchy]] of five powerful families. The Quintad families had originated from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], but immigrated to the relatively insignificant Eriadu in [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]]. Under the Quintad's oversight, Eriadu was made into an industrial giant and one of the most prestigious planets in the Outer Rim, fulfilling the Quintad's desires to transform Eriadu into the "[[Coruscant of the Outer Rim]]."

Although consisting of five influential families, the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]] was the most powerful and famous family of the Quintad, dominating politics in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and throughout the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
Of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] ancestry,<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Quintad were an [[oligarchy]] of five influential and driven families that dominated [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu's]] politics and industries. The Quintad made up a portion of Eriadu's privileged few, otherwise consisting of a handful of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] business leaders and high-level [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]]. These wealthy magnates enjoyed opulent excesses and resided in palatial estates that dot the outskirts of [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]].<ref name="GATORW:46" />

The Quintad shared their name with [[Quintad Orbital Manufacturing]], a manufacturing firm that was dominated by the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]] in the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
===Rise to prominence===
Originally hailing from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the powerful and ambitious Quintad emigrated to [[Eriadu]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in approximately [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]],<ref name="EA" /> establishing a ruling [[oligarchy]] over the planet.<ref name="GATORW:46" /> At the time of their emigration, Eriadu was best known for its local delicate shellwork jewelry, though the driven families of the Quintad sought to remake the planet into the "[[Coruscant of the Outer Rim]]."<ref name="EA" />

By the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Eriadu had turned into an economic powerhouse under the Quintad's leadership and guidance.<ref name="TEGTW" /> The Quintad had developed Eriadu into a manufacturing giant with prestigious shipyards and caused the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] to move its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] from [[Seswenna/Legends|Seswenna]] to Eriadu, rerouting the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] into Eriadu and establishing it as a major Outer Rim planet.<ref name="GATORW:46" /> However, under the Quintad's rule, the planet suffered from serious pollution<ref name="EA" /> and depended on a substantial [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] population, only liberated under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="GATORW:46" />

===Galactic affairs===
[[File:Tarkin-SWG4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wilhuff Tarkin was a member of the Quintad's leading family]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Eriadu was a bastion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] amid [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] sectors.<ref name="EA" /> The Quintad's [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]] rose to prominence during the war, with [[Brigadier]] [[Gideon Tarkin]] assisting Republic forces in battle,<ref name="GATORW:46" /> while his brother [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] oversaw the Republic's [[Eighteenth Army]].<ref name="EA" />

After the Republic was reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Greater Seswenna was reorganized into [[Oversector Outer]], making Tarkin the most powerful man in the Outer Rim.<ref name="EA" /> After Tarkin's death and the fragmentation of the empire, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]] established the [[Eriadu Authority]] based around the Seswenna sector. Having wed an heiress of the Tarkin family, Delvardus had the support of the Quintad, though the five families wielded great influence over him. When Delvardus pushed toward conquering Coreward, he fell out with Eriadu's ruling families and thereupon lost the support of the Quintad<ref name="Despoilers2" />―the Quintad was concerned with defending the Eriadu system's interests, not Coreward expansion.<ref name="EA" />

==Notable members==
The [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]] was the most famous<ref name="EA" /> and powerful of the five Quintad families, who dominated the high offices of the Seswenna sector's corporations, shipyards, and political parties.<ref name="TEGTW" />

The [[Eriadu News Service]] reporter<ref name="TGOKA">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref> [[Eris Harro/Legends|Eris Harro]] was the heiress of one of the Quintad houses and was wed to [[Shea Hublin]] after he was named [[Air Marshal|air marshal]] of [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Greater Seswenna]] and granted a marquisate on Eriadu.<ref name="TEGTW" />
